reviews.notes: A tapered cranium with broad cheeks replaces the old spherical puffer silhouette.
The long pipe nozzle is gone; short lips, a dark cavity, muzzle pad, and lower jaw form the outlet.
Side-set eyes, pupils, subtle brows, gill plates, fins, and dorsal crests remain readable from front, side, and three-quarter views.
Each jet begins at the transformed position of the named mouth socket rather than a manually estimated point.
The optimized Blender close-up retains the sculpt, optimized GLB re-import passes, and the rebuilt Unity prefab remains within all budgets.
